rv.q: Director Daniel Fish, whose dark version of Rodgers and Hammerstein’s “Oklahoma!” similarly featured some distracting avant-garde touches, nevertheless provides a useful historical perspective with this production.
Fish presents all of this material with a directorial flourish that yields moments of surprising humor, a blend of documentary or verbatim theater with elements of theater of the absurd.
Daniel Fish again proves his genuine creative genius with the wildly entertaining and unpredictable Kramer/Fauci.

cn.t: Critics praise this gripping recreation of Larry Kramer and Anthony Fauci's 1993 AIDS debate as an "extraordinary hour" of controlled fury, with strong performances bringing the historic C-SPAN clash to vivid, absorbing life.
